verdict.rationale: Cake documents round modelling: it says you can model your raise, see the dilution, and run SAFE and convertible-note raises (cake-equity-docs-7, cake-equity-docs-19), and round modelling is listed as included in the plan (cake-equity-docs-18). The evidence does not show the priced-round mechanics the story asks for, and investor communication is mentioned only generically. Missing for 10: option pool top-up modelling, SAFE/note conversion into a priced round, pro-forma ownership output, sharing a modelled scenario with counsel and investors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
